entries.reason: @atproto/api 0.29.6 is the latest release and still depends on zod ^3.23.8. The advisory is patched only in zod 4.6.6, a breaking major that would change AT Protocol response validation. The package is used solely by the Bluesky adapter, and the vulnerable path needs an oversized constrained collection in a PDS response. Remove this exception once @atproto ships zod 4 support or the adapter stops using the SDK.
